pronosticsHub.heroP2: Perfect for a WhatsApp group, the office colleagues or the family. From Ligue 1 to the World Cup.
pronosticsHub.a1: Yes. Creating a prediction tournament, inviting your friends and playing is 100% free. Paid plans only exist for large groups or bonus options, but you don't need them to have fun.
pronosticsHub.q2: Do you play with real money?

pronosticsHub.q3: Which competitions can I play on?

pronosticsHub.q4: How do I invite my friends to a tournament?

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How do the free tournaments (Free-Kick) work?
faq.a1: Each user can take part in up to 2 free tournaments at the same time, limited to 10 matchdays and 5 players. Need more? Buy an invite slot (0,99 €), extend the duration (3,99 €) or increase the number of players (1,99 € for +5 players).
faq.q2: How do One-Shot and Elite Team work?
faq.a2: The creator pays once (4,99 € or 9,99 €) and can invite up to 9 (One-Shot) or 19 (Elite Team) players for free. Each player can only be invited for free to a single premium tournament at a time.
faq.a3: Yes, all payments are handled by Stripe, the global leader in online payments. We never store your banking information.
faq.a4: The creator pays 6,99 € and each participant must also pay 6,99 € to join. The tournament starts from 11 registered players and can host up to 30 participants. The winner takes home an official jersey!
faq.q5: What is a free one-off competition?
